topic: Hanna's square-exponent congruence modulo six, its two companion congruences, and Yanev's general divisor-sum radical identity extending Fried's exponent-two case
title: Proof of Hanna's square-exponent congruence and an extension of Fried's divisor-sum formula

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: For Paul D. Hanna's conjecture in OEIS A226838, revision 14, FORMULA, we prove that every factorial-normalized coefficient of exp(sum_{m>=1} x^(m^2)/m^m) is an integer congruent to one modulo six by Carlitz's coefficient recurrence, and extend Sela Fried's Theorem 3 (2025, page 3) on Yanev's divisor-sum identity to all positive exponents. The same argument proves the modulo-three and modulo-thirty conjectures in A226839 and A226890, with all three uniform moduli optimal. A necessary and sufficient coefficient criterion gives a sharp weighted extension; the linked divisor-sum entry's elementary identities also follow.
summary: All-index written proofs of the congruences in A226838 modulo six, A226839 modulo three, and A226890 modulo thirty, with a necessary and sufficient transfer criterion, optimal moduli and a sharp weighted extension. Yanev's positive-exponent radical identity extends Fried's earlier exponent-two theorem. Three pinned Lean declarations state the two original rational-series congruences and the multiplied-out radical identity; the other statements have written proofs. Exact finite coefficient and divisor checks accompany the note.
